posts.title: RTX 5080 + RTX 3090 Setup: 80+ Tok/s on Qwen 3.6 27B Q8

posts.title: Toying Around With Xv6 X86
posts.description: From the project’s Github repository : xv6 is a re-implementation of Dennis Ritchie’s and Ken Thompson’s Unix Version 6 (v6). xv6 loosely follows the structure and style of v6, but is implemented for a modern x86-based multiprocessor using ANSI C.
